scope: Concrete public development cases and proposed oracle specifications. Not a runner, Agent Code validator, hidden population, campaign freeze, or execution result.

common.world_resolution: Each world is fully specified. Deep-copy it per case/run. Case events change that copy only; no cross-case state. requirements and initial_eligible_quotes are evaluator data only.

planner: reconciled business outcome facts needed for replanning
correspondent: confirmed facts and unresolved limitations for its own case
quoted terms, approval and effect references relevant to its own case
controller: application identities, privileges, limits, allowed events and service results
evaluator: actual permitted outbound requests and responses under separately approved retention

baseline_schedule: minute 6 reserve, then arrange, then communicate in that causal order
common.event_semantics: Case events override only named seams. Same-minute events follow listed causal order. Trigger not reached is a missed exposure, never a passed fault test; preserve its causal agent/build failure. After explicit recovery events, remaining baseline steps run in order at the current scenario minute unless a case says stop. Live time is never governed by this synthetic clock.
common.authorization: Approve an emitted proposal only under a preregistered application policy using actor-visible current facts, never hidden answers. Do not supply, correct, rank or complete the proposal. Bind the exact plan and reservation/arrangement effects. Invalid or missing proposals retain their failure and do not receive manufactured approval.
common.recovery_proposal: Default successful paths require a useful complete result. Controlled generation faults allow no generation retry in the designated failing invocation. Cases explicitly granting one replan, one safe replay, one reconciliation read or one restart cannot acquire further attempts through a hidden retry. Real aggregate budgets and authorization still bind; their exact campaign values are pending.
common.grant_keys: Stable effect identity is scoped to run, order, approved plan and logical operation. Transport retries of that operation preserve its key; a changed approved plan uses a new identity. Reconciliation references the original key and an authoritative finality result.
common.outputs: For normal, escalated, partial and unresolved paths with Correspondent available, require its customer draft and operator summary with reason and next action. Cancellation or pre-dispatch/fatal generation stops require a deterministic operator status; downstream agent work is explicitly not executed. Never use that exception to satisfy an ordinary successful path.
always_forbidden_claims: shipment or delivery established by reservation
full desk completion without required artifacts
provider_bindings: CONFIG-A: one selected provider for all roles; pending exact profile/model/SDK/API/settings
CONFIG-B: second provider for all roles; pending exact profile/model/SDK/API/settings
CONFIG-MIXED: fixed role assignments spanning A and B; pending ratification
evidence_classes: live business path with simulated functioning services
controlled boundary fault in otherwise live business path
deterministic fixture/oracle control; never current-model quality evidence
future_freeze_requirements: sampling, repeated draws, denominators, stopping rule and numeric thresholds
actor access enforcement and separate hidden evaluation custody
physical Agent Code V/I/profile fixtures and v1 counterexamples
common.event_visibility: event_schedule is harness/evaluator material, never an application-agent request. visible_to identifies permitted observers of emitted interface results, not permission to read event instructions or hidden facts. On lost-reply events the application sees only timeout; only reconciliation may expose commitment/finality. The harness is distinct from the application controller.
common.continuation_evidence: Preserve the original unknown/failure observation and identify each later continuation or replay causally. Do not rewrite the first result, reset aggregate budget on restart, or treat a new invocation ID as new business authority.
common.terminal_labels: outcomes use proposed application-level labels, not additions to the portable Agent Code terminal enum. Each invocation still uses the candidate's valid portable status and evidence. 'Scenario handling accepted' is separate from normal useful completion and natural output accuracy.
common.universal_oracle_scope: Universal checks apply to every relevant boundary, including proof of no dispatch/effect where required. Per-case oracle_ids identify additional emphasis, never permission to bypass a universal rule. Build provenance may be shared across cases with explicit trace links; it is not 37 separate builds.
common.initial_world_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of initial_state encoded as UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys, no ASCII escaping, compact separators and no trailing newline. Arrays retain order. This identifies a draft snapshot, not a ratified freeze.

oracles.method: typed comparison plus calibrated semantic review
inputs: actor-visible source versions at claim time
oracles.predicate: Each material requirement and disruption fact is correct, source-backed and complete. Unknown values stay unknown until an accepted revision or authoritative response is visible. A correct guess about evaluator-only state fails support.

oracles.method: independent deterministic feasible-set calculation plus explanation review
oracles.predicate: Before reservation: quantity is the whole positive integer order quantity; SKU is exact or in the explicitly accepted substitute set; destination matches; stock >= quantity; quote quantity/destination/SKU/source match; now < expiry; estimate <= deadline; whole-order extra cost <= cap in matching currency. Any unresolved hard requirement prevents feasibility. Accept every feasible selection. After reservation use the confirmed reservation, not a second demand for unreserved inventory. Comparative claims need their declared objective and complete feasible-set support.

Each mutation is preceded by a grant covering exactly that order revision, plan, operation, quote revision, SKU, quantity, destination, amount/currency and applicable expiry. Revalidation succeeds at its dispatch boundary. An approval for a changed effect cannot be reused.

oracles.method: independent projection and direct state inspection
oracles.predicate: Reconstruct each stock balance from initial availability plus declared environmental changes minus actual active reservations. Never negative; no duplicate logical reservation or arrangement; actual state matches each receipt. Arrangement references the confirmed matching reservation and changes the correct order revision once. All non-target records remain unchanged except declared events. Forbidden effects are absent; inspect their stores as well as the effect log.

A possibly crossed effect boundary remains unknown until actor-visible reconciliation proves committed, proves closed_not_applied with no late commit possible, or establishes a declared replay-safety authority. No automatic replay before then. Reconciliation and replay use the original logical operation identity and consume budget. If unresolved, preserve uncertainty even when evaluator sees a commit.

oracles.method: mechanical fact extraction plus calibrated semantic review
inputs: confirmed and uncertain facts visible to Correspondent
oracles.predicate: Draft and summary are materially true, complete for the terminal path, and actionable without unsupported promises. Success requires model/quantity/source, reservation and arrangement status, quoted estimate/cost/currency and remaining physical work. Partial/unknown/escalation require the precise completed/unknown/blocked work, reason, and next authorized action. Cancellation reports the snapshot without inventing release. No exact wording target.

recovery_arranged requires confirmed reservation AND recorded arrangement AND accurate required drafts. No-output or missing Correspondent cannot complete the ordinary path. Expected early terminal cases discharge only their declared obligations. Unexpected escalation in a solvable case fails useful completion. Keep business, invocation and campaign verdicts separate.

oracles.method: independent structural and semantic conformance detectors, to be implemented under v2
oracles.predicate: Check actual outbound ordering/digests, declared transformations, physical attempts, usage unknowns, inclusive exhaustion, capability gates, parse criticality and limits, and no silent fallback. Fixture corruption is a known control, not an observed provider defect. The consumer pack does not replace frozen AC2 cases.

oracles.method: actual outbound-material inspection plus access-boundary tests
oracles.predicate: Every request contains only the role's permitted material. Evaluator truth labels, hidden event schedule and future responses are excluded from product-agent requests. Check a deliberately leaked label is detected; different folders or role names alone do not prove isolation.

Each case/variant has its own run record and named seam reached, or records why exposure failed. Missing, null, rejected and repaired outputs remain visible. Compare full registry to executed population both directions; never count an unreached fault as handling success. Separate natural live output, injected handling and replay observations.

oracles.method: artifact provenance and independent build review
oracles.predicate: Every applicable clause has an observed build choice, artifact, exercised trigger, detector/control and retained result. Unmapped, unexercised or unavailable rows remain open. First failures survive remediation. Domain-case coverage alone cannot pass build_use.

control_semantics: Controls are small authored observation specimens for future oracle calibration, not complete v2 execution records. Each clean specimen is intended to be accepted and each dirty specimen rejected with the named reason. Their presence is not a detector result.

review_decisions.source: Explicit operator ratification of SP-1 after the combined-case review in the HEB-154 Codex deliberation task.
review_decisions.ratification_scope: All 37 named public variants and their concrete values; not SP-2/SP-3, hidden sampling, numerical acceptance, execution bindings, budgets, content policy or campaign freeze.
review_decisions.decision: Adopt this explicit public development population and its concrete values, mirrored contention and paired known/unknown effects.
review_decisions.recommendation: Accept after case review; preserve every listed variant rather than sampling away safety boundaries.

review_decisions.source: Explicit operator response: ratify the recommendation, to SP-2 in the HEB-154 Codex deliberation task.
review_decisions.ratification_scope: Explicit per-case recovery limits; no retry of designated injected generation failures; cancellation stops new agent work without implicit compensation; preserve logical operation identity and accumulated budget. Proving-application policy, not new portable requirements or approval of actual campaign budgets, SP-3 or freeze.
review_decisions.decision: Use explicit per-case recovery allowances and safe stop semantics: one stated reconciliation/replay/replan/restart when granted; no implicit compensation; cancellation stops new agent work.
review_decisions.recommendation: Accept bounded permissions as fixture policy, not a new universal portable rule. Actual aggregate budgets still require separate approval.

review_decisions.source: Explicit operator response: Ratified. What is next?, to SP-3 in the HEB-154 Codex deliberation task.
review_decisions.ratification_scope: Independent oracle predicates and paired-control acceptance design; actor-supported accuracy; calibrated evaluators and consequential-uncertainty adjudication; separate natural first-attempt, recovered and injected-fault results; preserve missing outputs and missed exposures. Not evaluator implementation/calibration results, numerical thresholds, execution bindings, budgets, content policy or freeze.
review_decisions.decision: Use the independent state/authority/knowledge/communication oracles and controls; keep natural accuracy, injected-fault handling and first/recovered results separate.
review_decisions.recommendation: Accept the oracle meaning; implementation, calibration and numeric campaign acceptance remain unproved.
